args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deployment. I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). All three regions are now serving v2.3.0, and the rollback has completed. Root cause of the v2.3.1 health check failures is still under investigation.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigated**: Reviewed checkout-api's deployment history and confirmed v2.3.1 (latest production release) was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent version healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollout completed successfully.
3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback action taken. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: The root cause of the v2.3.1 health check failures remains unknown and is flagged in the incident for further investigation.
